messages:
tara: Quick kickoff — we need to get the AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings moving. Goal: staging listings + trial SKU by next Tue. Need owners for: IAM/KMS networking, SKU packaging & metering config, EULA/terms + legal signoff, marketing assets (logos/screenshots), and a preflight runbook. Who can own which piece?
ben: I can take IAM/KMS + sandbox networking. Will validate VPC peering and provide sample role.
anika: I'll own SKU packaging, pricing tiers, and trial entitlements. Need to confirm bundle names and seat vs token billing.
mike: tagging onto ben for any infra hooks. For Private Offer / marketplace entitlements we need a short deployment note for customers. I'll draft that.
sophie: I can do legal review for EULA & contract clauses. Timeline: I need final copy by Mon EOD to keep on track. Any special data residency asks?
tara: thanks — @ben for infra, @anika for product, @sophie for legal. @raj can you handle the assets+docs handoff?
raj: Yep — I'll coordinate screenshots, hero images, and the quickstart doc. Can you add SSO notes?
ben: putting a quick IAM example here to speed things up — use minimal trust for marketplace deployer role:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow","Principal": {"Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com"},"Action": "sts:AssumeRole"}
  ]
}
```
anika: SKU manifest draft (super light) — feedback pls:
```yaml
sku_id: rwinf-pro-1
public_name: Redwood Inference Pro
trial: 14d
billing_model: seats
tiers:
  - name: dev
    seats: 5
    price_monthly: 200
```
sophie: YAML looks fine from a terms perspective. Need to confirm trial cancellation/refund language. Also attach localized EULA variant for EU.
marketplace-bot: Created checklist #MP-722 (staging-submission) and assigned to Tara, Ben, Anika, Sophie. https://internal.redwood/marketplace/checklists/MP-722
tara: Great. Quick risk note: Azure wants an explicit KMS key policy and proof of key rotation window for compliance. @ben can you include a KMS policy snippet?
ben: will do, adding rotation window and key alias mapping. Also, for metering we need to decide whether to emit token counts or session hours to cloud billing. Thoughts?
anika: prefer token-based for accuracy, but marketplace metering sometimes prefers 'units' — I'll map tokens -> units in packaging and include conversion table.
mike: FYI — Dedicated customers may prefer a seat model lumped into marketplace; make sure manifest supports both.
raj: I'll add both screenshots and a short note explaining unit mapping in quickstart. Also will surface the EULA link in the docs.
sophie: action: I'll deliver EULA draft by Mon 10am PT with EU localization notes.
tara: action: I'll coordinate submission windows with each marketplace and block time for the actual upload on Tue. Proposed timeline: Mon morning final checks, Tue afternoon submission. Is that ok?
ben: ok from infra side. I'll push a small terraform snippet to the partnership repo for reviewers.
anika: I'll finalize SKU names + pricing matrix by Mon noon.
mike: I'll draft the Private Offer deployment note by Mon EOD.
raj: assets ready by Mon noon.
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketplace-preflight MP-722 on 1769999200.
tara: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping this thread. Thanks all :rocket: 
Action items: 
- ben: IAM/KMS policy + terraform snippet (due Mon EOD)
- anika: SKU manifest + pricing matrix (due Mon noon)
- sophie: EULA + EU localized variant (due Mon 10am PT)
- mike: Private Offer deployment note (due Mon EOD)
- raj: marketing assets + quickstart docs (due Mon noon)
- tara: schedule upload windows + submit Tue afternoon
(Will run preflight checklist MP-722 Mon afternoon)
